title: Senior Marketing Professional
jobDescription:
Designation : Senior Marketing Professional

Location : Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai

Experience : 12 years to 15 years

Qualification : MBA


Job Description :

We are a global, specialized IT services firm, partnering with select customers in BFSI, Telecom, and Healthcare. Our strength lies in personalized engagement, niche expertise, and high-impact delivery in Development, Testing, and Cloud Services.

Key Roles and RESPONSIBILITIES:

We are seeking a Senior Marketing Professional who can own and drive the marketing function end-to-end. This is a strategic yet hands-on role, ideal for someone who blends strategy, digital-first execution, and AI-enabled marketing to strengthen our brand presence and enable high-value sales. As a storyteller and market shaper, you will position us as a trusted partner in the IT services space.

What You’ll Do :

  • Shape the Narrative: Build a compelling brand voice that highlights our niche positioning and value proposition.

  • Drive Intelligent Marketing: Design and execute digital-first and database-driven campaigns with a clear focus on measurable outcomes.

  • Leverage AI: Use AI tools to elevate content creation, campaign targeting, and lead insights.

  • Create Premium Content: Develop thought-leadership articles, case study decks, videos, and executive decks that open doors with high-value clients.

  • Engage Selectively: Strengthen our presence across website, social media, and curated industry events to reach the right audience.

  • Enable Sales Excellence: Collaborate closely with sales and engineering teams to provide world-class presentations, pitch decks, and executive briefings.

What you bring :

  • 12 to 15 years of marketing experience in the professional IT services industry with exposure to BFSI, Telecom, or Healthcare amongst others.

  • Proven ability to own and drive marketing initiatives independently, elevating brand positioning and supporting sales in high-stakes deals.

  • Expertise in CRM, marketing automation, and analytics tools.

  • Strong skills in storytelling, executive presentation design, and stakeholder engagement.

  • A data-driven yet creative mindset, with comfort in AI-driven platforms.


Key Performance Metrics

  • Growth in qualified, high-value leads aligned with boutique positioning.

  • Sharper brand recall within BFSI, Telecom, and Healthcare.

  • Increased digital engagement and conversions from focused campaigns.

  • Executive-ready presentations and narratives that resonate with CXOs.

  • Clear ROI and efficiency gains through AI-enabled marketing.

If you are a senior marketing professional who thrives on ownership, independence and impact and who values focus over scale and the power of storytelling, this is your opportunity to make a visible difference in a specialized IT services company.

title: QA Engineer.
jobDescription:
Designation: Manual Tester

Location: Mumbai (Ghansoli)

Experience: 3 to 4 years

Qualification: BSc, MSc, B.Tech, M.tech


Job Description:

As a Manual QA Engineer, your primary responsibility will be to ensure the quality, reliability, and functionality of software applications used in the Securities/Capital Markets domain. You will work closely with developers, business analysts, and product owners to identify defects early and help deliver high-quality software.


Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct thorough testing of software applications, including API testing, functional testing, and regression testing. API testing experience is Mandatory.

  • Develop and execute manual test cases to ensure the quality and reliability of software products.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve software defects promptly.

  • Participate in requirements analysis and provide feedback on testability and potential quality issues.

  • Perform database testing to validate data integrity and ensure accurate system functionality.

  • Stay up-to-date with industry best practices and emerging trends in software testing and quality assurance.

  • Securities/Capital Markets domain experience is mandatory, as the learning curve is significant without domain knowledge.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.

  • Experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on manual testing.

  • Strong knowledge of API testing and experience using tools such as Postman or Soap UI.

  • Proficiency in functional testing techniques and methodologies.

  • The candidate should have automation awareness. Although this is a manual testing role, they should be comfortable working in an automation-enabled environment and understand the overall automation process.

  • Experience testing databases using SQL queries and database management systems (e.g., My SQL).

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.

  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • We are looking for someone who is a good problem solver, not just a tester who executes test cases. The candidate should be able to analyze issues, understand the root cause, and work closely with the team to drive resolutions.

title: Test Automation Engineer
jobDescription:
Designation: Test Automation Engineer
Location:  Bangalore & Hyderabad
Experience: 3 to 5 years
Qualification:  B.E / B. Tech /M.E / M. Tech /M.Sc. / MCA


Job Description:
Prime Soft is seeking test automation engineers with experience in automation testing using Cucumber framework and Playwright tool with solid understanding of SDLC process, test automation concepts, automation tools, and frameworks. The automation engineer will perform all or most of the following:

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • GUI, functional and API testing and automation of web application and REST APIs, by applying latest techniques in test automation and using AI powered test automation tool.
  • Analyze the business requirements, design and develop manual test cases with good coverage using AI Test Automation Agent.
  • Understand the test automation requirements and analyze the test cases for automation.
  • Design and develop automation framework using Playwright, C# and BDD (preferably Spec Flow)
  • Design, develop and enhance the test automation scripts. Using appropriate coding and naming standards while developing framework APIs and utilities.
  • Unit testing framework APIs and utilities.
  • Design and develop automated test scripts using appropriate coding and naming standards.
  • Review test scripts, document review comments and assist junior engineers to address review comments.
  • Execute test scripts, analyze failures, report defects and generate test execution reports.
  • Develop test automation related documentation such as framework/script design documents, release notes, readme, help documents, API documentation.
  • Demonstrate the Sprint deliverables to customer. 
  • Communicate confidently with customers, manage stakeholder expectations and ability to operate under pressure and meet project deadlines.
  • The selected candidate shall be a self-starter and work independently on identified modules and take ownership of designing and developing test cases and test automation scripts.

Mandatory Skills:
  • Experience in test automation using C# and Play Wright.
  • Strong knowledge of automation testing using BDD (Spec Flow or Cucumber)
  • Experience with test automation of REST APIs and web application.
  • Experience with CI/CD process and GIT.
  • Experience in Agile or Scrum methodologies.

Additional Skills:
Knowledge on Jira, Zephyr, Confluence.
